use_case: Computer-vision crop yield prediction from drone imagery (block-level marketable yield 1 to 3 weeks ahead), feeding harvest planning, sales commitments, crew planning (AI-006), and draft H-2A job orders
vendor_or_model: In-house computer-vision and forecasting models (Data Science Lead) on Cloud provider B AI services
data_categories: Drone RGB and multispectral imagery (SYS-10); block boundaries, varieties, planting dates; historical block yields from tally totals (no per-worker data)
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: harvest crews, including H-2A workers, through crew plans and job order drafts)
consequential_decision_category: Employment (through AI-006 crew planning and draft H-2A job orders)
human_in_the_loop: Agronomists review block estimates against hand counts; the Director of H-2A and Labor Compliance reviews every job order draft; no hours are cut on an estimate alone
applicable_laws: 20 CFR 655.122(i) three-fourths guarantee and (j)(1) hours-offered records; federal equal employment opportunity laws (counsel review); FTC Act Section 5 (accuracy of any external yield claims); no state AI law applies in FL, GA, SC, or NC (cross-sector register as of 2026-09-25)
committee_review: Reviewed 2025-11-12 (Medium); re-tiered High and re-reviewed 2026-07-15; full assessment 2026-08-26
protected_characteristic_inputs: None as model inputs; worker group effects arise downstream through AI-006 crew plans
bias_testing_status: Accuracy tested by crop, variety, region, and season stage; bias testing of downstream crew plans by worker group incomplete (POAM-021, due 2027-01-31)
monitoring: Weekly error by block in season; monthly subgroup bias check; model version recorded with each forecast

use_case: Irrigation scheduling recommendations (FMIS planning module plus company soil moisture models), offered to company farms and to SL-1 growers
business_owner: Vice President, Irrigation and Water Resources
vendor_or_model: FMIS vendor planning module configured with company soil moisture and weather models
data_categories: Soil moisture probes, weather stations, crop stage, flow history
consequential_decision_category: None (operational advice); becomes Safety/CI if schedules execute automatically
human_in_the_loop: Operators accept or edit every recommended schedule; interface validation (SI-10) rejects out-of-range values before SCADA
applicable_laws: None specific; water use permits limit withdrawals
bias_testing_status: Not applicable (no individuals affected); accuracy by soil type and crop reviewed monthly
monitoring: Monthly accuracy review; rejected recommendation rate

monitoring: Seasonal precision and recall against agronomist confirmation

use_case: Variable-rate fertilizer and seeding prescription maps executed by guided equipment
vendor_or_model: FMIS agronomy model with company soil data
data_categories: Soil samples, yield maps, imagery, field boundaries

use_case: Crew planning and labor demand forecasting (crew sizes, hours, and H-2A job order drafts built from AI-001 forecasts)
data_categories: AI-001 forecasts; crew rosters (worker ID, crew, skills, availability); hours-offered history

applicable_laws: 20 CFR 655.122(i) and (j)(1); federal equal employment opportunity laws (counsel review)

monitoring: Weekly hours offered per worker across crews; monthly group comparison once testing is in place
